title: MLZ landing zone
description: A layer of landing zone settings: landing-zones/_defaults/all.yaml, _defaults/<env>.yaml, <workload>/_workload.yaml or <workload>/<env>.yaml. Each says only what differs from the one above.

owner.description: The owning team's email address. Becomes the Owner tag, and gets the budget alerts unless budget.contacts names others.

cost_center.description: The cost center. Becomes the CostCenter tag.

archetype.description: The management group the subscription goes into: corp, online or sandbox (local only when governance turns it on).

location.description: The Azure region, one of governance's allowed regions with a hub, for example norwayeast.

subscription.description: The landing zone's subscription ID, handed to vending before this file is merged.

monthly.description: A whole amount per month, in the subscription's currency. No monthly, no budget.

contacts.description: Who gets the budget alerts, as email addresses (default: the owner).

network.description: The spoke network. Its addresses come from the IP allocator, in _generated/ip-plan.yaml, never from here.

size.description: The range's prefix length, from 16 to 28. The IP allocator gives out the block.

subnets.description: Each subnet's name to its prefix length, up to 29 (default: one subnet, default, a /26 or the whole of a smaller range).

organization.description: The GitHub organization of the landing zone's repo. Set it once, in _defaults/all.yaml: from then on vending makes every landing zone a repo, named by customer.yaml's naming.repository.

repo.description: An existing repo to use instead of one vending makes: vending only trusts it.

create.description: false: no repo for this landing zone, for example a sandbox. Vending makes one by default once github.organization is set.

team.description: The owning team's GitHub team, by its slug: Maintain on the repo, and its apply's reviewer. Set it once per workload, in _workload.yaml.

short_name.description: The workload's short name in every name (docs/naming.md): 2 to 5 lower-case letters and digits, unique among workloads. Default: the workload's folder name, when it fits. Set it in _workload.yaml.

names.description: Explicit names, which win over the template; only in the landing zone's own file. A changed name replaces the resource.

network_resource_group.description: An explicit name for the resource group, instead of the template's.

identity_resource_group.description: An explicit name for the resource group, instead of the template's.

virtual_network.description: An explicit name for the virtual network, instead of the template's.

route_table.description: An explicit name for the route table, instead of the template's.

deploy_identity.description: An explicit name for the user assigned identity, instead of the template's.

budget.description: An explicit name for the budget, instead of the template's.

plan_identity.description: An explicit name for the user assigned identity, instead of the template's.

state_resource_group.description: An explicit name for the resource group, instead of the template's.

state_account.description: An explicit name for the storage account, instead of the template's.

network_security_groups.description: An explicit name for a subnet's NSG, by the subnet's name.

decommission.description: true retires this landing zone: its plan destroys everything vending made and moves the subscription to Decommissioned. Only in the landing zone's own file.

tags.description: Extra tags. Owner, CostCenter, Environment, Workload and ManagedBy are set for you.
